# Expected QEMU boot sequence (AG9-A; ordered and made live at WS-BP BP8.1)
#
# Each non-comment line is a substring the QEMU boot log must contain, and the
# lines must occur IN THIS ORDER: scripts/test_qemu.sh requires each fragment
# on a line after the previous fragment's line, so a phase that runs out of
# sequence fails as surely as one that does not run.  Every fragment is
# mandatory.
#
# The sequence is the boot core's phases (rust/sele4n-hal/src/boot.rs's
# rust_boot_main): the banner, the entry level and the PSCI conduit it
# selects, the early per-core pointer, translation on, the vectors, the
# interrupt controller, the timer, IRQs unmasked, secondary bring-up, the
# handoff summary.  The lane runs it on QEMU's `virt` at both entry levels
# (WS-BP BP8.1), so no fragment names a board; the entry-level lines are the
# lane's own per-run checks.
#
# Format: CHECK_NAME | expected_fragment

BOOT_BANNER | booting on
ENTRY_LEVEL | [boot] Entered at EL
PSCI_CONDUIT | [boot] PSCI conduit:
TPIDR_SET   | TPIDR_EL1 set early (Phase 1) to PER_CPU_DATA
MMU_INIT    | [boot] MMU enabled (identity map
VBAR_SET    | [boot] VBAR_EL1 set to exception vector table
GIC_INIT    | [boot] GICv2 initialized
TIMER_INIT  | [boot] Timer initialized
PER_CPU_ID  | current_core_id_from_tpidr() = 0
IRQ_ENABLE  | [boot] IRQ delivery enabled
SMP_PHASE   | [boot] Phase 6:
HANDOFF     | [boot] Hardware initialization complete:
BOOT_DONE   | [boot] Boot complete
